rule: Every refusal / stop in the real execution path names a gate from this file. The file records, per gate, what it rests on, where it applies and what happens. It does not forbid numbers: a monitored quantity with a stated basis and scope may stop a run. What stays forbidden is listed under 'forbidden'.

hard.command_malformed: non-finite or malformed command / trajectory sample
hard.servo_range: goal outside the servo's own Min / Max_Position_Limit (EEPROM, read from the device)
hard.device_calibration_mismatch: the device's Min / Max_Position_Limit differ from the calibration snapshot in use
hard.bus_lost: a bus read or write failed (the driver's own packet timeout) or the port could not be opened
hard.servo_fault: the servo's Status register is non-zero (its own fault / protection report); at rest it read 0 on all 12 motors
hard.operator_stop: stop requested by the operator (stop file / interrupt)
hard.stale_position: a write would be based on a Present_Position that was not read in the same cycle
hard.port_owned: the port is held by another process
hard.torque_state: the arm is not in the torque state the mode requires (another controller may own it); left as it is
hard.collision_verified_frame: contact on the commanded path in a VERIFIED coordinate system (not reachable while the joint mapping is a candidate)

provisional.model_joint_range_candidate: goal outside the joint range of the assembled dual model, through the CANDIDATE mapping (verified=false). Applies to model-dependent paths (ACT / HYBRID, model-derived targets), not to device-level commissioning
provisional.collision_candidate_frame: contact on the commanded (nominal) path in the SIM scene through the CANDIDATE mapping. Applies to model-dependent paths only
provisional.owner_not_connected: the command owner needs something the real arm does not have yet (REAL gripper profile)
provisional.certificate_binding: a collision result that belongs to another trajectory / mapping (structural identity, no number)
provisional.input_not_usable: read-only observation rules of the loop: a camera stream that missed more than one of its own measured frame intervals, a wrist frame that fails the stationary integrity rule. They refuse an OBSERVATION; they never gate a motor write by themselves

contract.profile_violation: the final trajectory exceeds the SELECTED motion profile (sweepick_motion_profile.json). The profile is the execution contract of the run, not a rating of the servo; a trajectory that breaks it is retimed by the generator or refused
contract.no_progress: sweepick_progress_profile.json: a commanded joint did not advance for longer than twice the longest normal start delay (first the command waits, then this). Basis: 13 traces of this robot; scope in that file. Reaction: stop pushing, hand over to the stop handling
contract.target_not_reached: after the command ended the measured position is not within the settled error seen on this robot (sweepick_progress_profile.json) or is still changing. Reaction: not reported as reached / returned; torque is not released on that ground
contract.measurement_invalid: the actual position of a commanded channel is missing or non-finite, or was not read in this cycle
contract.status_unavailable: the Status register is required for fault monitoring and could not be read; a missing status is not a status of 0

forbidden: an arbitrary cap on the total travel (ticks or degrees), under any name
a normal opening hard-coded per object width
re-using the removed 30-tick / 2-tick / 50 % gates under another name
